notes.title: 【 Complete v1.0 Version 】 The ending has been updated and the game has been comp
notes.notes:
After accidentally releasing the game, it took 3 months to finally release the complete version= w=
This update includes all remaining content, galleries, and 2 endings of the game.
【 Minor modifications 】
1. Slightly increased the difficulty of working at street restaurants
2. Significantly reduced the difficulty of achieving success
3. Added gold coin rewards for gold coins
4. Add some hidden achievements.
Please check the specific content in the game.

notes.title: [Version update on October 12, 2024] Added new store and new animation.
notes.notes:
1. Open the Dream Magic Street store - [Cosplay Store] (the protagonist needs to wear a nun's uniform to enter)
2. Added the labor and animation of tentacle spawning.
3. Added tentacle bed H animation
4. Added tentacle bed berserk mode H animation. (The protagonist needs to first take the Seed of Corruption and then interact with the tentacle bed)
5. Add a bed on the left side of the cosplay store, now you can sleep outside of your home.
6. The store has added a new product - fishing rod upgrade. (You can upgrade three times and earn more coins when fishing successfully)
7. Reduced the difficulty of triggering achievements.
8. A teleportation array has been added to the left side of Mengmo Street, allowing the protagonist to quickly return home while in regular server mode.
The above is the content of this update.
[November Full Version Preview]
In November, two more stores on Mengmo Street will be launched with ending triggers.
There are currently two expected outcomes.
Coming soon!
